en: Black‑and‑white view of a historic European market square. In the center stands a large Baroque/Neoclassical town hall with a steep roof and a central tower bearing a clock and a small cupola. In front of it is a busy open-air market with stalls under awnings and numerous people in early-20th‑century clothing. To the right is a large Gothic church with a tall tower capped by an onion-shaped dome. Surrounding buildings are multi‑story townhouses typical of central European old towns.
